m: अ-वशा f. not a cow, a bad cow, AV. xii, 4, 17 and 42.
a: अवशा — Ved. Not a cow, a bad cow.

m: अव-शान्त mfn. (√ शम्) extinguished, AitBr.

v: na॰ ava + Sada--Ric--taN lyuw । 1 nASane 2 SIrRatA karaRe । “mAMsAnAmavaSAtanaM SvayaTurdaMSakoTa” iti suSrutaH
m: अव-शातन n. (√ शद्, Caus.), withering, drying up, Suśr.
a: अवशातनं — 1 Destroying, cutting or lopping off. --2 Withering, drying up. --3 Emaciation.

m: अव-√ शॄ (impf. अवाशृणात्) to break (as any one's anger), PBr. : Pass. (impf. -शीर्यत) to be dispersed, fly in every direction, R. i, 37, 13 ed. Bomb.
अव-√ शी Ā. (3. pl. शीयन्ते; Imper. -शीयताम्) to fall or drop off, AV. xviii, 3, 60; TS.; Kāṭh.; ŚBr.; PBr.
अ-वशी-भूत mfn. unrestrained, independent, L.
uninfluenced by magic, L.
a: अवशीभूत — a. 1 Unrestrained, independent. --2 Not influenced by magic.

m: अव-शीन or अव-श्यान, mfn. coagulated, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 26.
a: अवशीनः — A scorpion.

m: अव-शीर्ण mfn. broken, shattered, Kauś.; MBh. xiii, 1503.

v: tri॰ avanataM SIrzaM yasya vA kap । 1 avANmastake । avAkSIrvAKye suSrutokte 2 SayyAdozaBede pu॰ “avAk SIrze dIrGanyubjottAnasaNkucitadehasTitatAdakziRapArSvaSA yinaH pradAnamiti sapta SayyAdozA” iti । 3 netrarogaBede nennavyApado'BiDAya “atipIqitavaddozAn viDiM cApyavaSIrzake” iti suSrutaH ।
a: अवशीर्ष --र्षक — a. [अवनतं शीर्षं यस्यवा कप्] Having the head bent down. --र्षः 1 An error made in sleeping (as regards position). --2 A kind of eye-disease.

m: अव-शीर्षक mfn. id., Suśr.
अव-शीत and -शीन See अव-श्या.
अव-शीत or अव-श्यात, mfn. cooled, cool, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 26, Kāś.

v: tri॰ nAstivaSamAyattatvaM yasya । 1 asvADIne, 2 kAmAdiparavaSe, 3 parADIne ca । “jagDvAhyaviDinA mAMsaM pretya tEradyate'vaSaH” manuH । kAryyate'hyavaSaH karmma sarvaH prakftijErguREH” “kAryyate'hyavaSo'pi san” iti ca gItA ।
m: अ-वश mf(आ)n. unsubmissive to another's will, independent, unrestrained, free,AV. vi, 42, 3 & 43, 3, &c.
not having one's own free will, doing something against one's desire or unwillingly, Mn. v, 33; Bhag. &c.
a: अवश — a. [नास्ति वशं आयत्तत्वं यस्य] 1 Independent, free. --2 Not compliant or docile, disobedient, selfwilled; स्त्री चावशा Pt. 1. 424; Ms. 5. 33. --3 Not subjected to or swayed; अवशो विषयाणां K. 45; uncontrolled, unrestrained; ˚इंद्रियचित्तानां H. 1. 18; 2. 182; Dk. 34; मधुरैरवशानि लंभयन् वशं Ki. 2. 55 wild. --4 Not master of oneself, subject to the senses; कमपरमवशं न विप्रकुर्युः Ku. 6. 95. --5 Not having one's own will, dependent, helpless, powerless; सकलमवशं सीदति जगत् H. 2. 77; कार्यते ह्यवशः Bg. 3. 5; K. 174; Pt. 1. 335; U. 3; कथमवशो ह्ययशोविषं पिबामि Mk. 10. 13; विमुंचंत्यवशा देहं कालस्य वशमागताः Rām.; Mu. 1. 12. --6 Necessary, certain; किमस्य भवतो यथा सुहृद एव नाशोऽवशः Mu. 6. --Comp. --इंद्रियचित्त a. whose mind and senses are not held in subjection.

m: अ-वश—ं-गम n. ‘not submissive to each other’, N. of a special Sandhi (in which the two sounds meeting each other remain unchanged), RPrāt.
a: अवशंगमः — Not submitting to another's will.

m: अ-वश—ग mfn. not being in any one's (gen.) power.

a: अवशक्थिका — = अवसक्थिका q. v.

s: tri, (avabadDe SakTinI yena .) vastrAdidvArA pfzWajAnujaNGAdvayadfQabanDanapUrvvakopavizwaH । PA~qabAnDiyA vasA iti BAzA । yaTA । kAtyAyanaH । “AsanArUQapAdastu jAnunorjjaNGayostaTA । kftAvaSakTiko yastu prOQapAdaH sa ucyate” ॥ AsanArUQapAdaH AsanArUQapAdatalaH । jAnunorjjaNGayoH kftAvaSakTiko vastrAdinA kftapfzWajAnujaNGAbanDaH । ityAhnikatattvaM ॥

m: अव-शप्त mfn. cursed, MBh. xiii, 7221.
अव-˚शर्धयितृ m. one who breaks wind upon or against, Viṣṇ.

v: tri॰ ava + Sansa--kvip । avavAde avaSaMsane “avaSasA niHSasA yat parAgaso pArima jAgrato yatsva pantaH” aTa॰ 6 । 45 । 2 ।
m: अव-शस् (only instr. -शसा) f. (√ शंस्), wrong desire, AV. vi, 45, 2.
a: अवशस् — f. [अव-शंस्-क्विप्] 1 A wrong desire. --2 Censure, abuse.

m: अव-√ श्चुत् (perf. -चुश्चोत) to trickle down, TBr.
अवशेन्द्रिय-चित्त mfn. whose mind and senses are not held in subjection, Hit.

v: pu॰ na॰ ava + Siza--BAve GaY । 1 kftapadArTasya Seze 2 samAptO ca “toyAvaSEzeRa himABamaBram” BawwiH karmaRi GaY । avaSizwe ।
m: अव-शेष n. leavings, remainder, Mn. viii, 159, &c.
often ifc., e.g. अर्धाव्˚, कथाव्˚, पिताव्˚, q.v.
अव-शेष &c. See अव-√ शिष्.
a: अवशेषः — Remnant, rest, leavings, remainder; रक्षसामवशेषेण, अह्नः, पुण्यानां Rām.; वृत्तांत˚ M. 5 the rest of the story; in this sense usually in comp.; अर्ध˚ having only one half left; कथा˚ or नाम˚ one who survives only in narration or name, having only the tale or name left behind; used figuratively for dead; see the words s. v.; भस्म˚ remaining only in ashes, reduced to ashes; Ś. 3. 3; भस्मावशेषं मदनं चकार reduced to ashes Ku. 3. 72, Śi. 10. 16; सावशेषमिव भट्टिन्या वचनं M. 4 unfinished; सावशेषो विषवेगः ibid. still remaining; शीर्षावशेषीकृतः Bh. 2. 34; Ratn. 2. 2; R. 2. 69; शृणु मे सावशेषं वचः Ś. 2 hear me out, let me finish my speech; अल्पावशेषायुः K. 46 having a short span of life; see निरवशेष also.

m: अव-शेषम् ind. ifc. so as to leave as a remnant, Daś. (cf. निर्-अव्.)
अव-शेष—ता f. the being left as a remainder, BhP.
अव-शेषित mfn. left as a remnant, remaining, MBh. i, 5129, &c. (cf. कथा-मात्राव्˚ and नाममात्राव्˚.)
a: अवशेषित — p. p. Left, remaining.

m: अव—शेष्य mfn. to be left or kept remaining.
अव-√ शृध् P. -शर्धयति, to break wind against, mock, defy, Mn. viii, 282
अव-√ शि (Imper. 2. sg. -शिशीहि) to deliver from, remove, RV. x, 105, 8.

a: अवशिका — = अवश; Mk. 1. 23.

m: अ-वशिन् mfn. not having one's own free will
not exercising one's own will, not independent, Āp.

v: tri॰ avanataM Siro'sya prA॰ ba॰ । avANmastake ।
m: अव-शिरस् mfn. having the head turned down, Kauś.
a: अवशिरस् — a. Having the head bent or hung down.

m: अवशि-त्व n. not being master of one's self, MBh. xiv, 1001
अव-√ शिष् Pass. -शिष्यते, to be left as a remnant, remain, TBr.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.: Caus. (Pot. -शेषयेत्) to leave as a remnant, MBh. v, 2638; R. v, 26, 38.
a: अवशिष् — (Used mostly in pass.) To be left last or as a remainder, to remain over or behind; Bg. 7. 2. --Caus. To leave as a remainder; देहमात्रावशेषितः Bhāg.

s: tri, (avaSizyate iti aba + Siza + kta .) SezaH । udvarttaH । avaSezASrayaH । yaTA, -- “balmIkamUzikotKAtAM madamantarjjalAM taTA । SOcAvaSizwAM gehAcca nAdadyAt lepamamBavAM” ॥ ityAhnikatattvaM ॥
v: tri॰ ava + Siza--kta । 1 atirikte, 2 pariSizwe, 3 aDike ca । “surAkAmadyUtakftaM daRqaSulkAvaSizwakam” yA॰ smf॰ “vAjiByovAjinamiti SrutO vAjinaM Ami kzAvavaSizwaM jalamiti raGu॰ ।
m: अव-शिष्ट mfn. left, remaining.
a: अवशिष्ट — p. p. 1 Left, remaining; स्तंबेन नीवार इवावशिष्टः R. 5. 15; किमवशिष्टमह्नः Ratn. 3; निद्रागमसीम्नः कियदवशिष्टं Mv. 6; कियदवशिष्टं रजन्याः Ś. 4 how much of the night yet remains (has yet to run). --2 Remaining over and above, surplus. --ष्टं, --ष्टकं Rest, remainder, remnant; Y. 2. 47.

m: अव-शिष्टक n. remainder, Yājñ. ii, 47.
अव-√ श्रथ् Caus. (Imper. 2. sg. -श्रथाय, Padap. ˚थय) to loosen, RV. i, 24, 15.

v: na॰ ava + Sri--lyuw । cUllIto'vatAryya sTApane । “aDiSrayaRAvaSrayaRAntAdipUrvvAparIBUtaH vyApArakalApaH pAkAdiSabdavAcyaH” sA॰ da॰ ।
m: अव-श्रयण n. (√ श्रि), taking (anything) from off the fire (opposed to अधिश्र्˚, q.v.), Sāh.
a: अवश्रयणं — Taking anything from off the fire (opp. अधिश्रयण); अधिश्रयणावश्रयणांतादिपूर्वापरीभूतो व्यापारकलापः पाकादिशब्दवाच्यः S. D. 2.

m: अव-√ शुष् -शुष्यति, to become dry, VāyuP. ii; (-शुष्यते), MārkP.
अव-श्वसम् Ved. Inf. fr. √ श्वस्, to blow away, AV. iv, 37, 3.
अव-√ श्वित् (aor. -अश्वैत्) to shine down, RV. i, 124, 11.

v: strI ava + SyE--ka । 1 kujJawikAyAm 2 anAyattAyAM striyAYca ।
m: अव-श्या f. (√ श्यै), hoar-frost, dew, L.
a: अवश्या — [अव-श्यै क] 1 Hoar-frost, a fog or mist. --2 An independent woman.

s: puM, (avaSyAyate SEtyamApadyate iti SyEN gatO + SyAdvyaDeti RaH । tato Ato yugiti yuk .) himaM । ityamaraH ॥ (“avaSyAyanipAtena kiYcitpraklinnaSAdvalA” । iti rAmAyaRe .) garvvaH । iti viSvaprakASaH ।
v: pu॰ ava + SyE--Ra । 1 kujJawikAyAm, “avaSyAyakaRAsrAvAScArumuktAPalatvizaH” BawwiH । 2 aBimAne ca । pf॰ hrasvaH avaSyayo'pi kujJawikAyAm ।
m: अव-श्याय m. (Pāṇ. iii, 1, 141) hoar frost, dew, Nir.; MBh. xii, 5334; R.
pride, L.
a: अवश्यायः — [अव-श्यै-ण P. III. 1. 141] 1 Frost, dew. --2 Hoarfrost, white dew अवश्यायावसिक्तस्य पुंडरीकस्य चारुतां U. 6. 29. --3 Pride.

k.v: अवश्यायस्तु नीहारस्तुषारस्तुहिनं हिमम्. प्रालेयं मिहिका चाथ हिमानी हिमसंहतिः॥

m: अवश्याय-किरण m. ‘cold-rayed’, the moon, Dhūrtan.
अव-श्याय—पट m. a kind of cloth, L.

s: vya, (na vaSyaM .) niScayaH । tatparyyAyaH । nUnaM 2 । niScitaM 3 । ityamaraH ॥ (“avaSyaM yAti tiryyaktvaM jagDvA cEvAhutaM haviH” । iti manuH ॥) (na + vaSa + yat .) anAyatte tri ॥
v: tri॰ na vaSyaH । anAyatte 1 anaDIne 2 durdAnte ।
m: अ-वश्य in comp. with a fut. p.p. (and with some other words) for अ-वश्यम्, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 144, Comm.
disobedient, KaṭhUp.; Pañcat.
a: अवश्य — a. 1 Untameable, ungovernable, unruly. --2 Inevitable; अथ मरणमवश्यमेव जंतोः Ve. 3. 4. --3 Indispensable, necessary. --Comp. --पुत्रः a son whom it is impossible to govern or teach.

अवश्यं — ind. [अव-श्यै-डमु Tv.] 1 Necessarily, inevitably; त्वामप्यस्रं नवजलमयं मोचयिष्यंत्यवश्यं Me. 93. --2 Certainly, at all events, by all means, surely, of course; अवश्यं याति तिर्यक्त्वं जग्ध्वा चैवाहुतं हविः Ms. 12. 68; अवश्यं यातारश्चिरतरमुषित्वापि विषयाः Bh. 3. 16; तां चावश्यं दिवसगणनातत्परामेकपत्नीं (द्रक्ष्यसि) Me. 10, 61. अवश्यमेव Most surely; if compounded with pot. pass. the final nasal is dropped; अवश्यपाच्य to be necessarily cooked; अवश्यकार्य to be necessarily done.

m: अ-वश्य—भागीयक mfn. inevitable, Divyāv.

a: अवश्यंभाविन् — a. Destined to take place, inevitable; ˚आदेशः M. 5; अवश्यंभावि लक्षणम् H. 3; अवश्यंभाविनो भावा भवंति महतामपि H. Pr. 28; Ś. 6.

m: अ-वश्य—कार्य mfn. (g. मैयूरव्यंसकादि, q.v.) to be necessarily done, R. ii, 96, 8
अ-वश्य—कार्य n. pl. necessary performances, MBh. i, 7899; viii, 10.

a: अवश्यक — a. Necessary, inevitable, indispensable.

v: na॰ avaSyaM karaRaM yogaviBAgAt malopaH । niyatakaraRe akaraRAnnivfttO “avaSyakaraRaYcAkaraRAnnivfttiH” prA॰ ta॰ raGu॰ ।

m: अ-वश्य—कर्मन् n. any necessary action or performance, AitĀr.

a: अवश्यकता, --त्वं — Necessity, obligation, certainty.

v: avya॰ ava + SyE--qamu । 1 niScaye 2 aSakyanivAraRE ca । “avaSyaM yAti tiryyaktvaM jagDA cEvAhutaM haviH” manuH “avaSyamBAvinyarTe vE santApo neha vidyate” BA॰ SA॰ pa॰ । “lumpedavaSyamaHkftye tumkAmamanasorapi” ityukteH kftyAnte malopaH avaSyapAcyam । “avaSyaBavyezvanavagrahagrahA” nEza॰ avaSyam BavaH WaY avyayasyawilopaH AvaSyakaH । avaSyamBave tri॰ । “etezvAvaSyakastvasO” BAzA॰ ।
m: अ-वश्यम् ind. necessarily, inevitably, certainly, at all events, by all means, अवश्यम् एव, most surely (cf. आवश्यक.)

k.v: प्रागतीतार्थकं नूनमवश्यं निश्चये द्वयम्. संवद्वर्षेऽवरे त्वर्वागामेवं स्वयमात्मना॥

m: अ-वश्य—म्-भाविन् mfn. necessarily being, MBh. i, 6144; Hit.
अ-वश्य—म्-भावि-ता, f. [Comm. on Mṛcch.] or अ-वश्य—म्-भावि-त्व, n. [Bhpr.] the being necessarily.
अ-वश्य—पाच्य mfn. to be necessarily cooked, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 65, Sch.

v: pu॰ avaSyaH putraH । SAsitumaSakye avaSIBUte putre । tasya BAvaH manojYA॰ vuY । AvaSyaputrakam tadBAve na॰ ।

m: अ-वश्य—यातव्यता f. necessity of marching against an enemy, Kām.

s: strI, (ava + SyE + Ra । pfzodarAditvAt hrasvaH .) kujJawikA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (kujJawikASabde'sya viSezo jYeyaH .)

m: अ-व—˚श्येन्द्रिय mfn. one who does not control his senses, MBh.
